text: This S1000D technical document is the title page for the s1kd-tools system, issued September 1, 2020 (issue 032). Produced by khzae.net, it serves as the introductory front matter for product documentation. The document is unverified and applies to all variants. It contains minimal descriptive content and functions primarily as a cover page.

This S1000D document is a reference guide providing a list of abbreviations and acronyms used in s1kd-tools documentation. It defines key terms including BREX (Business Rules EXchange), CIR (Common Information Repository), CSDB (Common Source Database), PCT (Product Cross-reference Table), and SNS (Standard Numbering System). Issue 004, dated May 1, 2020, unverified status.

This S1000D document is a table of contents for the s1kd-tools system, issued September 1, 2020 (issue 038). It is an English-language reference document maintained by khzae.net. The document provides an organizational index for s1kd-tools documentation and applies to all applicable systems. It is marked unverified and was issued as a routine upissue.

This S1000D data module documents the s1kd-tools software package and provides a list of effective (current, valid) data modules. Issued September 1, 2020 (Issue 030) by khzae.net, it applies to all configurations. The module serves as a reference index or catalog of active data modules within the s1kd-tools system.

This S1000D document is a status/highlights information module for the s1kd-tools software system. Published September 1, 2020 (issue 057) by khzae.net, it serves as a highlights or release notes document applicable to all configurations. The document contains minimal content and is marked as unverified, with the update reason listed as "Upissue."

This S1000D technical document provides a comprehensive reference guide for .defaults file identifiers used in s1kd-tools software. It contains an alphabetically organized index listing all valid identifier names with descriptions of their permissible values, along with practical examples demonstrating .defaults file usage in both XML and text formats. The document was last updated in September 2020 to replace the "includePrevSnsTitle" identifier with "snsLevels."

This S1000D data module provides an introductory overview of the s1kd-tools software suite and their role within S1000D technical publication standards. It defines key concepts including S1000D itself (an international specification for modular technical documentation), Common Source Databases (CSDB), and explains how s1kd-tools support the full S1000D workflow: generation, authoring, validation, and publication of reusable data modules.

This S1000D technical documentation provides comprehensive usage examples for the s1kd-tools software suite. It covers initial project setup, configuration file creation (.defaults and .dmtypes), CSDB population using Data Management Requirements Lists, CSDB object creation workflows, and data module validation and management procedures including schema validation, BREX compliance checking, and publication workflows.

This S1000D document provides installation and uninstallation instructions for s1kd-tools software. It covers two primary installation methods: using package managers with pre-compiled Debian (.deb) and Red Hat (.rpm) packages, and building from source. The document details system requirements, build procedures, Windows compatibility, and removal steps for both installation approaches.

This S1000D data module documents the s1kd-syncrefs command-line tool, which automatically extracts external references (dmRef, pmRef, externalPubRef) from S1000D data module content and populates a refs element. It describes the tool's purpose, usage syntax, command-line options including parser configuration flags, exit codes, and includes a usage example.

This S1000D document describes the **s1kd-validate** tool, a command-line utility for validating S1000D CSDB XML objects. It details the tool's purpose of checking XML well-formedness and schema compliance, provides complete usage syntax and command-line options (including schema validation, output filtering, and XML parser configuration), explains XML catalog setup for offline schema resolution, documents exit status codes, and includes practical examples.

# Summary

This S1000D document describes the **s1kd-instance tool**, a command-line utility for creating customized instances of S1000D CSDB objects. It specifies the tool's purpose (filtering master documents by applicability, skill level, security classification, and CIR dependencies), its command-line syntax, and comprehensive documentation of all supported options and their behaviors for content instantiation and delivery customization.

This S1000D technical documentation describes the **s1kd-brexcheck** tool, a command-line utility that validates S1000D CSDB objects against BREX (Business Rules EXchange) data modules. The document details the tool's purpose, usage syntax, comprehensive command-line options (including BREX validation, SNS checking, and XML parsing configuration), and operational features like severity level handling and SNS checking modes. Version 039 issued September 2020, developed by khzae.net.

# Description

This S1000D document describes the **s1kd-upissue** tool, a command-line utility for incrementing issue and in-work numbers of S1000D CSDB (Common Source Data Bank) objects and similarly-named files. It specifies the tool's purpose, usage syntax, and comprehensive option flags for controlling upissuing behavior, quality assurance settings, change markup handling, reasons for update, and XML parser configuration.

This S1000D technical manual describes the **s1kd-ls** command-line tool, which searches directories and lists S1000D CSDB (Common Source DataBase) object files matching specified criteria. The document details the tool's usage, command-line options for filtering by object type (data modules, ICNs, publication modules, etc.), issue status, and file permissions, plus XML parser configuration options. It includes practical examples demonstrating common use cases.

This S1000D data module is a technical description of the **s1kd-newdm** tool, a software utility for creating new S1000D data modules. It documents the tool's purpose, usage syntax, and comprehensive command-line options for specifying data module metadata such as codes, issue numbers, security classifications, languages, originators, and S1000D standard versions. The document was issued in September 2020 and includes recent updates regarding XML catalog parser options and SNS level parameters.

This document is a technical reference manual for the **s1kd-ref tool**, an S1000D utility that generates XML reference elements for various CSDB objects (data modules, publication modules, comments, etc.). It provides comprehensive usage instructions, detailed command-line options, configuration parameters, and practical examples demonstrating how to create properly formatted XML references from either S1000D codes or filenames, including optional metadata like issue information, language, and titles.

# Description

This S1000D documentation module describes the **s1kd-metadata** command-line tool, which fetches and modifies metadata in S1000D CSDB objects. It provides detailed usage instructions, comprehensive option documentation (including filtering, formatting, and XML parser configuration), and practical examples demonstrating how to query, edit, and batch-process metadata across multiple S1000D XML documents.

This document describes the **s1kd-uom** tool, a utility for converting units of measure in S1000D technical data. It specifies the tool's purpose (automated unit conversion and localization in data modules), provides comprehensive usage syntax and command-line options, and documents configuration files (.uom and .uomdisplay) and conversion formulas. The document was updated in September 2020 to add XML catalog parser support.

This S1000D data module describes the **s1kd-appcheck** tool, a validation utility for S1000D CSDB objects. It documents the tool's purpose (detecting applicability errors during filtering), usage syntax, and comprehensive command-line options for configuring validation modes, input/output handling, ACT/CCT/PCT references, and XML parser settings. The module also specifies exit status codes and covers recent feature additions including duplicate annotation checking and XML catalog support.

This document is a technical manual describing the **s1kd-newpm** tool, a utility that creates new S1000D publication modules with specified codes and metadata. It covers the tool's general purpose, usage syntax, comprehensive command-line options (including parser configuration), reference to a `.defaults` configuration file, and usage examples. The document is part of the S1KDTOOLS technical documentation set, issued in September 2020.

This S1000D technical documentation describes the s1kd-neutralize command-line tool, which generates neutral metadata for CSDB objects including XLink attributes using S1000D URN scheme and RDF/Dublin Core metadata. The document specifies the tool's usage syntax, comprehensive command options (such as delete, overwrite, list, namespace, and output controls), XML parser configuration options, and practical examples demonstrating metadata neutralization of data module references.

This S1000D document describes the **s1kd-newcom** command-line tool, which creates new S1000D comments with specified codes and metadata. It documents the tool's general purpose, usage syntax, comprehensive command-line options (including code, issue version, output path, templates, security, language settings, and XML parser configurations), and provides an example invocation. The document was updated to add the `--xml-catalog` parser option.

This document is a user guide and reference manual for the **s1kd-newddn** tool, a command-line utility for creating new S1000D data dispatch notes (DDNs). It provides comprehensive documentation including the tool's purpose, usage syntax, detailed option descriptions covering code specification, output paths, templates, metadata fields, and XML parser configuration, along with practical examples.

This S1000D technical documentation describes the **s1kd-repcheck** tool, a validation utility that checks Common Information Repository (CIR) references within S1000D CSDB objects. The document provides comprehensive usage instructions, including command-line options for validating, listing, and managing CIR references; parser configuration settings; and guidance on creating custom XSLT scripts to extract and validate non-standard reference types.

This S1000D document describes the s1kd-mvref tool, a utility that redirects all references from one object to another across specified S1000D data modules. It provides the tool's general purpose, command-line syntax, comprehensive option definitions (including content filtering, directory processing, and XML parser configuration), and practical usage examples for batch reference migration operations.

This S1000D technical documentation describes the **s1kd-acronyms** tool, a utility for managing acronyms in S1000D data modules. It explains three primary functions: generating lists of unique acronyms, automatically marking up acronyms based on predefined lists, and removing acronym markup. The document details extensive command-line options, usage syntax, the `.acronyms` configuration file format, and practical examples for common operations.

This S1000D technical documentation describes the **s1kd-newdml** command-line tool, which creates new S1000D data management lists (DMLs) with specified codes and metadata. The document provides general overview, usage syntax, comprehensive option definitions (including code, issue, output path, templates, BREX, security, defaults, and XML parser configuration), details on the `.defaults` file format, and practical examples of tool invocation.

This S1000D document describes the s1kd-dmrl tool, a utility that processes S1000D data management lists to automatically generate CSDB objects using s1kd-new commands. It specifies the tool's purpose, usage syntax, and comprehensive command-line options including issue selection, output directory, template configuration, parser settings, and error handling modes.

The **s1kd-refs** tool is a command-line utility for analyzing external references within S1000D CSDB (Common Source Database) objects. It identifies dependencies like ICNs, data modules, and publications; matches references to actual files in the CSDB directory; detects broken references; and can update reference metadata. The document provides comprehensive usage instructions and detailed option descriptions for managing reference dependencies in technical documentation.

This S1000D technical documentation describes the s1kd-aspp tool, a software utility for processing applicability statements in S1000D data modules. It explains the tool's two primary functions: generating human-readable display text from semantic applicability logic (using assert/evaluate elements) and preprocessing semantic applicability statements into simpler presentation formats for XSLT stylesheets. The document provides comprehensive usage instructions, command-line options, configuration details, and specifications for .disptext files that control display text generation formatting.

This S1000D document describes the s1kd-addicn tool, a utility that adds required DTD entity and notation declarations to S1000D modules to enable referencing ICN (Illustrative Content Notation) files. It provides usage syntax, detailed command-line options, and practical examples for operating the tool.

This S1000D technical manual describes the **s1kd-index** command-line tool, which automatically inserts index flags into S1000D XML data modules based on keywords defined in a project's `.indexflags` configuration file. The document specifies the tool's usage syntax, command-line options (including file overwrite, case-insensitive matching, and XML parser settings), the `.indexflags` file format, and includes practical examples demonstrating how keywords are matched and tagged within module content.

This S1000D data module describes the **s1kd-defaults** command-line tool, which generates and manages configuration files (`.defaults`, `.dmtypes`, `.fmtypes`) for S1000D CSDB projects. It documents the tool's purpose, usage syntax, all command-line options, the `.brexmap` mapping file format, and practical examples for initializing new databases and converting between text and XML formats.

This S1000D document describes the s1kd-newupf tool, a utility that generates S1000D data update files by comparing two versions of a CIR data module. It specifies the tool's purpose, command-line usage syntax, supported options (including S1000D issue selection, output path control, template customization, and XML parser configuration), required arguments for source and target modules, and includes a practical usage example.

This S1000D data module documents the **s1kd-fmgen** tool, a software utility for generating front matter content in S1000D technical publications. It describes the tool's purpose (creating content sections for front matter data modules like tables of contents, lists of abbreviations, and highlights), provides usage syntax, details all command-line options and parameters, explains the `.fmtypes` configuration file format, and specifies supported front matter types and XML parser options.

This document is a technical description of the s1kd-newsmc tool, a software utility that creates new S1000D SCORM content packages. It specifies the tool's purpose, command-line usage syntax, comprehensive options for configuring package metadata (code, language, security classification, etc.), XML parser configuration settings, and includes a usage example.

This is a Data Management List (DML) document—a master index for S1000D technical documentation on "S1000D tools." Published June 25, 2018 by khzae.net, it catalogs multiple related documents including front matter (title page, abbreviations, table of contents), business rules exchange specifications, and descriptions of various software utilities (s1kd-syncrefs, s1kd-validate, s1kd-instance, s1kd-brexcheck, and others) used for managing S1000D-compliant technical publications.

This is the publication module (table of contents) for s1kd-tools documentation, issue 031, dated September 1, 2020. It provides a hierarchical index of data modules covering the complete s1kd-tools software suite, organizing references into sections: Front matter, Introduction, Tools for generating data, Tools for authoring and managing data, and Tools for validating data. Each section contains links to individual data modules describing specific tools, their usage, and functionality.
